sn22.89:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā therā bhikkhū Kosambiyaṃ viharanti Ghositārāme || || 2
sn22.89:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Khemako Badarikārāme viharati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno || || 3
sn22.89:1.3: Atha kho therā bhikkhū sāyaṇhasamayam paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhitā āyasmantaṃ Dāsakam āmantesuṃ || ||
sn22.89:1.4: Ehi tvam āvuso Dāsaka yena Khemako bhikkhu tenupasaṅkama || upasaṅkamitvā Khemakam bhikkhum evaṃ vadehi || ||
sn22.89:1.6: Kacci te āvuso khamanīyam kacci yāpanīyaṃ kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikammanti no abhikkamanti || paṭikammosānam paññāyati no abhikkamoti || || 4
sn22.89:1.7: Evam āvuso ti kho āyasmā Dasako therānam bhikkhūnaṃ paṭissutvā yenāyasmā Khemako tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Khemakaṃ etad avoca || ||
sn22.89:1.8: Therā taṃ āvuso Khemaka evam āhaṃsu || ||
sn22.89:1.9: Kacci te āvuso khamanīyaṃ || la || no abhikkamo ti || || 5
sn22.89:1.10: Na me āvuso khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ || || la || || abhikkamosānam paññāyati no paṭikkamo ti || || 6
sn22.89:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā Dāsako yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā there bhikkhū etad avoca || ||
sn22.89:2.3: Na me āvuso khamanīyam || la || abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamo ti || || 7
sn22.89:2.4: Ehi tvaṃ āvuso Dāsaka yena Khemako bhikkhu tenupasaṅkama || upasaṅkamitvā Khemakam bhikkhum evaṃ vadehi || ||
sn22.89:2.5: Therā taṃ āvuso Khemaka evam ahaṃsu || ||
sn22.89:2.6: Pañcime āvuso upādānakkhandhā vuttā Bhagavatā || seyyathīdaṃ
sn22.89:2.8: imesu āyasmā Khemako pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu kiñci attānaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassasīti || || 8
sn22.89:3.1: Evam āvuso ti kho āyasmā Dāsako therānam bhikkhūnam paṭissutvā yenāyasmā Khemako tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā || la ||
sn22.89:3.2: Therā tam āvuso Khemaka evam āhaṃsu || ||
sn22.89:3.3: Pañcime āvuso upādānakkhandhā vuttā Bhagavatā || seyyatthīdaṃ ||
sn22.89:3.5: Imesu āyasmā Khemako pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu kiñci attānam vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassatīti || || 9
sn22.89:3.6: Pañcime āvuso upādānakkhandhā vuttā Bhagavatā || seyyathīdam
sn22.89:3.8: imesu khvāham āvuso pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu na kiñci attānaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassāmīti || || 10
sn22.89:4.1: Atha kho āyasmā Dāsako yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā there bhikkhū etad avoca || ||
sn22.89:4.3: Pañcime āvuso upādānakkhandhā vuttā Bhagavatā || seyyathīdam
sn22.89:4.5: imesu khvāham āvuso pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu na kiñci attānaṃ va attaniyaṃ vā samanupassāmīti || || 11
sn22.89:4.6: Ehi tvaṃ āvuso Dāsaka yena Khemako bhikkhu tenupasaṅkama || upasaṅkamitvā Khemakam bhikkhum evaṃ vadehi || ||
sn22.89:4.7: Therā taṃ āvuso Khemaka evaṃ āhaṃsu ||
sn22.89:4.8: Pañcime āvuso upādānakkhandhā vuttā Bhagavatā || seyyathīdam
sn22.89:4.10: No ce kirāyasmā Khemako imesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu kiñci attānaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassati ||
sn22.89:5.1: Evam āvuso ti kho āyasmā Dāsako therānaṃ bhikkhūnam paṭissutvā yenāyasmā Khemako || pa ||
sn22.89:5.2: therā taṃ āvuso Khemaka evam āhaṃsu || ||
sn22.89:5.3: Pañcime āvuso upādānakkhandhā vuttā Bhagavatā || seyyathīdaṃ
sn22.89:5.5: No ce kirāyasmā Khemako imesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu kiñci attānam vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassati || tenahāyasmā Khemako arahaṃ khīṇāsavo ti || || 13
sn22.89:5.6: Pañcime āvuso upādānakkhandhā vuttā Bhagavatā || seyyathīdaṃ
sn22.89:5.8: Imesu khvāham āvuso pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu na kiñci attānaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassāmi || na camhi arahaṃ khīṇāsavo || ||
sn22.89:5.9: Api ca me āvuso pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu asmīti adhigatam ayam aham asmīti ca na samanupassāmī ti || || 14
sn22.89:6.1: Atha kho āyasmā Dāsako yena therā bhikkhū || pa ||
sn22.89:6.4: Pañcime āvuso upādānakkhandhā vuttā Bhagavatā seyyathīdaṃ
sn22.89:6.6: imesu khvāham āvuso pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu na kiñci attānaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassāmi || na camhi arahaṃ khīṇāsavo || ||
sn22.89:6.7: Api ca me āvuso pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu asmīti adhigataṃ ayam aham asmīti na ca samanupassāmiti || || 15
sn22.89:7.1: Ehi tvaṃ āvuso Dāsaka yena Khemako bhikkhu tenupasaṅkama || upasaṅkamitvā Khemakam bhikkhum evaṃ vadehi || ||
sn22.89:7.2: Therā tam āvuso Khemaka evam āhaṃsu || ||
sn22.89:7.3: Yam etam āvuso Khemaka asmīti vadesi kim etam asmīti vadesi || ||
sn22.89:7.4: Rūpam asmīti vadesi aññatra rūpā asmīti vadesi ||
sn22.89:7.8: Viññāṇam asmīti vadesi aññatra viññāṇā asmīti vadesi || ||
sn22.89:7.9: Yam etam āvuso Khemaka asmīti vadesi kim etam asmīti vadesīti || || 16
sn22.89:8.1: Evam āvuso ti kho āyasmā Dāsako therānam bhikkhūnam paṭissutvā yenāyasmā Khemako tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Khemakam etad avoca || ||
sn22.89:8.2: Therā tam āvuso Khemaka evam ahaṃsu || ||
sn22.89:8.3: Yam etam āvuso Khemaka asmīti vadesi kim etam asmīti vadesi || ||
sn22.89:8.4: Rūpam asmīti vadesi aññatra rūpā asmīti vadesi ||
sn22.89:8.8: Viññāṇam asmīti vadesi aññatra viññāṇā asmīti vadesi || ||
sn22.89:8.9: Yam etam āvuso Khemaka asmīti vadesi kim etam asmīti vadesīti || || 17
sn22.89:8.10: Alaṃ āvuso Dāsaka kiṃ imāya sandhāvanikāya
sn22.89:8.12: aham eva yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkamissāmīti || || 18
sn22.89:9.1: Atha kho āyasmā Khemako daṇḍam olumbha yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā therehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn22.89:9.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyam vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 19 Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Khemakaṃ therā bhikkhu etad avocuṃ || ||
sn22.89:9.3: Yam etam āvuso Khemaka asmīti vadesi kim etam asmīti vadesi || ||
sn22.89:9.4: Rūpam asmīti vadesi aññatra rūpā asmīti vadesi ||
sn22.89:9.8: Viññāṇam asmīti vadesi aññatra viññāṇā asmīti vadesi || ||
sn22.89:9.9: Yam etam āvuso Khemaka asmīti vadesi kim etam asmīti vadesīti || || 20
sn22.89:9.10: Na khvāham āvuso rūpam asmīti vadāmi || ||
sn22.89:9.14: Na viññāṇam || Na pi aññatra viññāṇā asmīti vadāmi || ||
sn22.89:9.15: Api ca me āvuso pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu asmīti adhigatam ayam aham asmīti ca na samanupassāmi || || 21
sn22.89:10.1: Seyyathāpi āvuso uppalassa vā padumassa vā puṇḍarīkassa vā gandho ||
sn22.89:10.2: Yo nu kho evaṃ vadeyya Pattassa gandhoti Vaṇṇassa gandho pi Kiñjakkhassa gandho ti vā sammā nu kho so vadamāno vadeyyāti || ||
sn22.89:10.5: Pupphassa gandhoti kho āvuso sammāvyākaramāno vyākareyyāti || || 22
sn22.89:10.6: Evam eva khvāham āvuso na rūpam asmīti vadāmi na pi aññatra rūpā asmīti vadāmi || ||
sn22.89:10.10: Na viññāṇam asmīti vadāmi na pi annatra viññāṇā asmīti vadāmi || ||
sn22.89:10.11: Api ca me āvuso pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu asmīti adhigatam ayam aham asmīti ca na samanupassāmi || || 23
sn22.89:11.1: Kiñcāpi āvuso ariyasāvakassa pañcorambhāgiyāni saññojanāni pahīnāni bhavanti || atha khvassa hoti yeva pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu anusahagato Asmīti māno Asmīti chando Asmīti anusayo asamūhato || ||
sn22.89:11.2: so aparena samayena pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassī viharati || ||
sn22.89:11.3: Iti rūpam iti rūpassa samudayo iti rūpassa atthagamo || ||
sn22.89:11.7: Iti viññāṇaṃ || iti viññāṇassa samudayo iti viññāṇassa atthagamo ti || || 24
sn22.89:11.8: Tassimesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassino viharato yo pissa hoti pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu anusahagato Asmīti māno Asmīti chando Asmīti anusayo asamūhato so pi samugghātaṃ gacchati || || 25
sn22.89:12.1: Seyyathāpi āvuso vattham saṃkiliṭṭham malaggahitaṃ tam enaṃ sāmikā rajakassa anuppadajjeyyuṃ ||
sn22.89:12.2: tam enaṃ rajako ūse vā khāre vā gomaye vā samam madditvā acche udake vikkhāleti || || 26
sn22.89:12.3: Kiñcāpi taṃ hoti vattham parisuddhaṃ pariyodātaṃ || atha khvassa hoti yo ca anusahagato ūsagandho vā khāragandho vā gomayagandho vā asamūhato ||
sn22.89:12.4: tam enaṃ rajako sāmikānaṃ deti || tam enam sāmikā gandhaparibhāvite karaṇḍake nikkhipanti ||
sn22.89:12.5: yo pissa hoti anusahagato ūsagandho vā khāragandho vā gomayagandho vā asamūhato so pi samugghātaṃ gacchati || || 27
sn22.89:12.6: Evam eva kho āvuso kiñcāpi ariyasāvakassa pañcorambhāgiyāni saññojanāni pahīnāni bhavanti || atha khvassa hoti yo ca pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu anusahagato Asmīti māno Asmīti chando Asmīti anusayo asamuhato ||
sn22.89:12.7: so aparena samayena pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassī viharati ||
sn22.89:12.8: Iti rūpaṃ iti rūpassa samudayo iti rūpassa atthagamo || ||
sn22.89:12.12: Iti viññāṇaṃ || iti viññāṇassa samudayo iti viññāṇassa atthagamo ti || ||
sn22.89:12.13: Tassa imesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassino viharato yo pissa hoti pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu anusahagato Asmīti māno Asmīyi chando Asmīti anusayo asamūhato so pi samugghātaṃ gacchati || || 28
sn22.89:13.1: Evaṃ vutte therā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ Khemakam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn22.89:13.2: Na kho pana mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ Khemakam vihesā apekhā pucchimha || api cāyasmā Khemako pahoti tassa Bhagavato sāsanaṃ vitthārena ācikkhituṃ desetuṃ paññāpetuṃ paṭṭhapetuṃ vivarituṃ vibhajituṃ uttānīkatuṃ || || 29
sn22.89:13.3: Tayidaṃ āyasmatā Khemakena tassa Bhagavato sāsanam vitthārena ācikkhitaṃ desitaṃ paññāpitaṃ paṭṭhapitam vivaṭaṃ vibhattaṃ uttānīkatanti || || 30
sn22.89:14.2: attamanā therā bhikkhū āyasmato Khemakassa bhāsitam abhinanduṃ || || 31
sn22.89:14.3: Imasmiñ ca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne saṭṭhimattānam therānam bhikkhūnam anupādāya āsavehi cittāni mucciṃsu āyasmato Khemakassa cāti || || 1
